read_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between reading network statistics

rate_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) for computing rate-based statistics

variance.description: Variance threshold for statistical smoothing of rate data

history_variance.description: Variance threshold for statistical smoothing of history data

sleep_time.description: Sleep interval in microseconds between UI refresh cycles

lifetime.description: Default lifetime (in seconds) for temporary interface entries

show_all.description: Whether to display all interfaces, including those with zero traffic

policy.description: Optional policy file path for custom interface handling

rxmax.description: Maximum RX bandwidth in appropriate units

txmax.description: Maximum TX bandwidth in appropriate units

max.description: Maximum bandwidth in bytes per second (for scaling graphs)
